cause.label: dilution_or_going_concern
cause.what_happened: No negative company news on 2026-10-01. The only release was a non-binding hydrogen-power LOI with VIVIFY (8-K accepted 08:30 ET). The stock gapped +1.2% and then fell 15.7% intraday on ordinary volume (1.1x). That is the third fall of 10% or more since 2026-09-23. The only identifiable seller is Yorkville's variable-price convertible, which converts at 95% of the lowest 5-day VWAP and had converted $13.34m into 5.4m shares by 2026-09-23. Sector-wide rare-earth weakness is in the background.

findings.finding: Yorkville's variable-price convertibles are an unfinished supply line through the window. About $12.4m of the May principal was left on 2026-09-23, a further $22m was funded 2026-09-17, both convert at 95% of the lowest 5-day VWAP, and the price is still about 17% above the effective conversion floor (about $1.96 = $1.86/0.95).
findings.mechanism_in_window: The conversion formula resets lower every session, and the 5-day lookback now includes today's low. Any conversion shares Yorkville still holds can be sold into the 10-02 session. The selling is continuous, not a dated event, and nothing shows it ended: three falls of 10% or more since the 09-23 conversion tally.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Since registered resale went effective on 2026-07-10, the stock is -55.8% over 60 sessions. This name's 14 comparable falls rose the next session only 4 times (median -2.73%). The 2026-09-30 fall of -12.4% was followed by today's -14.7%.
findings.why_not_priced: The fall is priced, but the remaining principal is not converted. At a $2.175 spot, $12.4m is about 5.7m shares, roughly 4-5 days of normal volume, before the $22m September tranche counts. If the overhang were priced, the stock would hold above the 95%-VWAP reset rather than make a new 52-week low (pos_52w 0.001) on ordinary volume. Offsetting this: the 5.4m registered shares were fully used by 09-23 and the 7.5m-share S-1/A is not effective, so new conversion shares have no registered resale route until it is. That is why p_up sits at 42 and not lower.
findings.independence: Short interest rose in step with the conversions (349,505 on 07/31 to 1,436,796 on 09/15), https://api.nasdaq.com/api/quote/EMAT/short-interest?assetclass=stocks. The 08-23 to 09-23 conversion pace ($5.775m to $13.34m) is from https://www.stocktitan.net/sec-filings/EMAT/8-k-evolution-metals-technologies-corp-reports-material-event-2ccfbfac75b9.html

outside_window.finding: The S-1/A registering up to 7.5m more Yorkville resale shares (filed 2026-09-24) is not effective (no EFFECT filing). The July S-1 went from filing to EFFECT in two days, so this one could land any day, but no date is sourced and no acceleration request is visible.

Floor-price event on the May debenture: if daily VWAP is below $1.86 on 5 of 7 trading days, Yorkville gets monthly cash amortization (1/5 of principal plus a 5% premium). The earliest it can trigger is 5 sessions out. A going-concern doubt is in the 2026-09-24 S-1/A.

Registration for the September $30.927m debenture's conversion shares is due by about 2026-10-17. Filing it releases the $2m second tranche, and effectiveness releases the $6.927m third, which is more convertible supply.
